rachel: Pushing v2.10.0-canary to pool-d at 07:18 UTC. Requesting quick smoke: kv-prefill, http-heartbeat, embed-synth. @deploy-bot please run canary-small.

deploy-bot: started smoke-suite (canary-small). probes: kv-prefill,http-heartbeat,embed-synth. ETA ~2m.

hao: Acceptance check: fail if kv-prefill p95 > 80ms OR embed-synth p95 > 220ms OR sustained 5xx > 0.5%.

sre-oncall: early telemetry: kv-prefill p95 in pool-d jumped to 122ms, prefix cache misses high. embed-synth OK so far.

deploy-bot: smoke-suite results:
- kv-prefill: FAIL (p95=125ms, cache-miss spike)
- http-heartbeat: OK
- embed-synth: OK
Canary status: FAIL (kv-prefill).

miguel: That's enough to block. Option: rollback pool-d only or pin to previous release v2.9.9. Prefer targeted rollback + pin.

# command
/deploy rollback inference --region pool-d --to-version v2.9.9 --reason "kv-prefill p95 spike"
/deploy pin inference --region pool-d --to-version v2.9.9 --reason "pin after prefill regression"
deploy-bot: Targeted rollback + pin initiated by miguel at 07:21 UTC. Rolling back pool-d -> v2.9.9. ETA ~40s. Will auto-run post-rollback kv-prefill check.

sre-oncall: Created INC-2026-820: kv-prefill-prefetch-pool-d. Collecting prefix-cache metrics and prefetch traces.

deploy-bot: Post-rollback kv-prefill: p95=39ms, cache-hit=98%. pool-d status: PASS. Canary overall: PASS (pool-d pinned to v2.9.9).

rachel: Good containment. Follow-ups: reproduce prefill regression with v2.10.0 quant profile, run extended prefill sweep in staging, and add transient alert: kv-prefill p95 > 80ms over 2m. Adding a line to release notes: "Targeted rollback in pool-d for kv-prefill regression; investigating cache prefetch behavior."

miguel: I'll take ownership of the repro attempt and updates to the changelog. Leaving thread open for traces. :white_check_mark:
